text: Millions of Californians have fled our state in the last 5 years – perhaps the thought has even crossed your mind.
That’s because California’s career politicians – from both political parties – have failed us!
They offer nothing but partisan bickering and play the blame game while Californians suffer. It’s time to demand change.
I'm a principled problem solver pursuing a common-sense agenda.

First - Reduce your cost of living. I’ll oppose every tax hike – like the crazy new Mileage Tax. I’ll fight price gouging by the government and corporations. And I’ll reduce utility and insurance rates by reforming costly mandates. Second - Stop wasteful spending. We must put a stop to rampant fraud and wasteful spending in high-risk government programs. Every dollar lost takes away from services for people who legitimately need help. Third – Enact Voter ID. A super-majority of Democratic, Republican, and Independent voters support Voter ID – so let’s just get it done so everyone can have trust and confidence in our elections.
To get these three priorities done, I’ll work with everyone to build consensus. People first, not politics.
As your Senator, I’ll stand up to the special interests, corporations, and lobbyists, so your voice is heard.
I ask for your support and your vote!

statement.disclaimer: The statements are the opinions of the authors and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
